meaning: calm seated idle breathing / quiet observation
motion_notes: subtle breathing only; tiny ear movement; small tail crystal flicker; eyes calm and alive; no dramatic pose change; stable scale across frames; stable bottom-center baseline; same character identity in every frame

reference_policy: Use approved ThunderPup reference images when provided by human. Do not infer missing traits freely. Preserve character identity over adding visual novelty. Concept sheets are reference / art canon only, not runtime sprites.

expected_output.sheet_layout: one full action sheet generated at once
expected_output.body_policy: full body inside safe area, no cropping, bottom-center baseline stable
